name: stocksense
description: StockSense - Modular Inventory & Warehouse Management System

scripts.setup:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv .venv && source .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend
scripts.dev: npx concurrently -k -n "backend,frontend" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm install && npm run build
